row:
Ima Survivor Sanctuary was created after the devastating floods from  Hurricane Harvey.  Along with our lone surviving donkey, Ima Jean, our farm now offers a forever home to other surviving farm-animals of the worst natural disaster in US history.  We have opened our doors as a rescue and have become a home to abandoned, abused, and neglected farm animals.  Although we may be a forever home to farm animals in need, we realize that 'we're all survivors of something' and we welcome you to join us as together we heal from life's ups and downs.  

imasurvivorsanctuary@thestation.io
